name: Social media - icon row
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media - icon row.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Native profile links only. A block URL takes precedence over the matching global social URL. Configure actual profiles; no account connection or live feed is provided.

settings.label: Eyebrow
settings.how: Enter the eyebrow. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.how: Turn on “Hide heading and description” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
